overview: The Ancestral Hall preserves the lineage, memory, and ritual identity of the Akhevan people.
history: Founded during the earliest Akhevan settlement era.
Crystal‑etched memorial spires were added to preserve ancestral resonance.
Void‑arcane remembrance chambers were constructed to stabilize lineage echoes.
Praesertum decrees formalized the Hall’s role in civic ritual.
Modern Hall serves as both archive and ceremonial nexus.
hooks: A lineage archive requests assistance with a corrupted record.
A ritual custodian seeks help stabilizing a remembrance chamber.
A Praesertum decree alters ancestral access protocols.
